title: Efficiency Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct formula for efficiency, eta, as derived from the work done and heat absorbed.

title: Correct Variables
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the variables v_g, v_ell, L_v, Delta p, and n in their calculations.

title: Clausius-Clapeyron Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the expression for dp_v/dT correctly using the efficiency from part (a).

title: Carnot Efficiency Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain why two Carnot engines operating between T and T - Delta T have the same efficiency.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in their calculations, particularly when dealing with Delta p and Delta T.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as n, are included in their final expressions.
